question: I’m full of pages but can’t speak. What am I?
I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter but can’t go outside. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
I run but never walk, I have a mouth but never talk. What am I?
I am light as a feather, yet the strongest person can’t hold me for much more than a minute. What am I?
What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have nobody, but I come alive with wind. What am I?
What can be broken, but is never held?
I have many teeth but cannot bite. What am I?
What goes up but never comes down?
What can you catch but not throw?
I am not alive but I grow; I don't have lungs, but I need air; I don't have a mouth, but water kills me. What am I?
I have one eye but cannot see. What am I?
I have hands but cannot clap. What am I?
The more you take away, the larger I become. What am I?
I have a neck but no head. What am I?
I can fill a room but take up no space. What am I?
